pages.title: A Tiny Colony
pages.text: Planks and another farm help separate growing colonies after the first actual production cycle.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Look for pupae around ant colonies. Hatch one that records you as owner, then use a recipe shown for the ant farm. Keep colonies with different abdomen colors apart.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use JEI to discover special Spawn recipes where registered. Guide can teach the native recipe interface.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Hatch an Ant Pupa and raise the ant. Hatched ants follow/protect their owner and distinguish other abdomen colors.
